BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   C. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

7. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of End - Of - Year Adjustments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Insurance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
